## Summary

- **Root cause fix**: `src/superclaude/examples/roadmap_template.md` shipped with 9 literal `u2014` ASCII strings where em-dash `—` should have been. Confirmed via `od -c` (bytes `u 2 0 1 4`, not encoded em-dash). Since commit 1073a309 embedded the template inline in the architect prompt, every architect run sees the corruption verbatim — Sonnet auto-corrects to em-dash, Opus follows the template literally and drops the dash plus the " and Mitigation" stem fragment, halting the pipeline on `template_sections_present`.
- **Defense-in-depth**: new cosmetic-failure auto-remediation lane that classifies gate failures as cosmetic vs semantic and deterministically rewrites pure-cosmetic failures (heading shape, dash variants, whitespace, smart-quotes, table padding, frontmatter trim, resource-subsection aliases) before halting. Semantic failures (missing milestones, placeholder leaks, OQ-xxx in deliverable IDs, frontmatter field absence) still halt.

## The failure that triggered this work

\`\`\`
[roadmap] Step generate-opus-architect  FAIL (attempt 2, 230s)
   Reason: Semantic check 'template_sections_present' failed: ...
ERROR: Roadmap pipeline halted at step 'generate-opus-architect' (attempt 2/2)
\`\`\`

Opus produced `### Risk Assessment` instead of `### Risk Assessment and Mitigation -- M{N}`. With the inline template containing `u2014` literals, Opus was asked to copy garbled text and chose to drop it.

## Test plan

- [x] Unit tests for C1-C11 transforms + classifier + idempotency + mixed-failure refusal (17/17 passing in `tests/roadmap/test_cosmetic_remediator.py`)
- [x] Regression sweep across executor + pipeline integration + halt + gates_data + cli_contract + models + validate_gates + dry_run + resume_restore (401/401 passing)
- [x] End-to-end smoke against the actual TUIBBS opus artifact: `_template_sections_present` was False before, True after **31 deterministic transforms** (29× milestone H3 + 2× resource H3). Idempotency confirmed.
- [x] `make sync-dev` succeeded
- [x] Lint clean on all modified files (pre-existing repo-wide ruff debt unrelated — see #60)

## Cosmetic-violation classes (C1-C11)

C1 stem alias / C2 missing `-- M{N}` suffix / C3 dash variants (incl. `u2014` literal) / C4 wrong heading level / C5-C6 trailing whitespace / C7 blank-line collapse / C8 smart-quote fold / C9 schema-matched table cell padding / C10 frontmatter trim / C11 Resource-Requirements subsection alias.

## Backwards compatibility

- `StepStatus.PASS` is preserved on auto-remediated steps (no new enum value). Existing call sites that pattern-match PASS keep working; new `remediated` / `remediations` fields on `StepResult` ride alongside.
- Default ON for user-friendly behavior; `--strict-no-remediation` preserves the old halt-on-any-failure contract.
- Non-roadmap gates (sprint, validate) are out of remediation surface by construction.

## Out of scope (intentionally — follow-up PRs)

- Production wiring of `remediation_summary` into the dynamic certify-step construction in `roadmap_run_step`.
- Architect-prompt hardening (worked few-shot example, terminal reminder, mid-generation per-section verifier).
- Canonical-heading authority in the merge step / reference-architect mode.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
title: fix(roadmap): repair u2014 template corruption + add cosmetic-failure auto-remediation lane
